edits.value_json: 《字源》 proposes “river” as the original meaning. Shang oracle-bone examples are reported in water or flooding contexts, but they do not establish that “river” was the earliest attested use. The sources differ: another account gives the broader meaning “water”; priority among these meanings remains unresolved.
